say:1:1033706001:1.text: Maybe. All things take time, after all.
say:1:1033706001:1.source_cn: 也许吧，但这一切还需要时间。
say:1:1033706001:1.male: Maybe. All things take time, after all.
say:1:1033706001:1.female: Maybe. All things take time, after all.

say:2:1033706002:1.text: And if this place really was the first to be corrupted, then the villagers have had plenty of time to travel.
say:2:1033706002:1.source_cn: 作为第一个遭受腐化的村庄，腐化的这段时间，足够那些村民...
say:2:1033706002:1.male: And if this place really was the first to be corrupted, then the villagers have had plenty of time to travel.
say:2:1033706002:1.female: And if this place really was the first to be corrupted, then the villagers have had plenty of time to travel.

say:3:1033706003:1.text: I just pray that the voices of the Windwhisperers will reach them...
say:3:1033706003:1.source_cn: 希望风语们传递的风讯，能被他们听到……
say:3:1033706003:1.male: I just pray that the voices of the Windwhisperers will reach them...
say:3:1033706003:1.female: I just pray that the voices of the Windwhisperers will reach them...
